paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者忙于熟悉任务，直到别人提起背景声已停才意识到变化；另一次关于光线的情境却记不清。明确提示后的察觉与缺少适用回忆分别保留，不把后者填成从未，也不从前者推断听力或神经阈值。例子只供阅读，不重放声音、测试警报或请别人秘密制造变化。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader engaged in a familiar task notices that a background sound stopped only after someone mentions it. A lighting example remains unclear. Noticing after an explicit cue and lacking applicable recall stay separate; the latter becomes no Never, and the former establishes no hearing ability or neurological threshold. The scene requires no replayed sound, alarm test or secretly created change.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只看虚构情境，什么发生了变化、何时得到提示、还有什么原因未知？”可以只读问题。听者不把晚察觉称为不认真或不可靠，不由均分提高提示强度，也不撤去既有无障碍安排；无需采集真实感官记录。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional change, an explicit cue and unknown causes. Read only the question if preferred. A listener labels no later noticing inattentive or unreliable, uses no mean to intensify cues and removes no existing accessibility arrangement. No actual sensory record is needed.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader chooses a familiar texture for added input but plays a recording on another occasion only to complete work. Similar outward actions need not have the stated reason; rate only an applicable situation and reason together. An input choice establishes no need for stronger stimulation. The scene assigns no listening, touching, movement trial or purchase.

paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional input, reason and task without trying two environments. A listener equates added input with neither extraversion, risk nor greater efficiency and subtracts no reducing-input score from it. Shared surroundings retain each person’s choices and existing support.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, recurring background sound interrupts reading while an unavailable seat change leaves the person in place. On another occasion, sound is noticed without interrupting the task. Interruption, noticing and available choices differ; remaining establishes no wish to endure. The scene requires no revisited setting, louder sound, prolonged exposure or tolerance test.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只读虚构过程，输入、注意被拉走和当时可选的调整分别是什么？”可以让不可判断的部分保留。听者不把频率变成敏锐度或自控分，不要求更多调整才承认不适，也不据结果移除安全信号、通风或他人的支持。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card distinguishes a fictional input, interrupted attention and available adjustments, leaving unclear details unresolved. A listener turns no frequency into acuity or self-control, requires no further adjustments before acknowledging discomfort and removes neither safety signals, ventilation nor someone else’s support.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者有两个同样可用的座位，因想少一些视觉变化而选其一；另一次选相同位置只是想坐朋友旁边。动作相同，题述原因不同，没得选时也不能假想选择。频率不说明调整有效或减少得够不够，例子不要求换座、改变设备或返回不舒服的环境。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader selects one of two available seats for less visual movement. On another occasion, the same seat is chosen to sit near a friend. The action matches but the stated reason differs; unavailable choices require no imagined answer. Frequency establishes neither effectiveness nor sufficient reduction. No seat change, altered equipment or return to discomfort is needed.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只用虚构座位，分开可以选择、实际选择和为什么选择，哪个仍未知？”无需说明真实场所。听者不把减少输入称为回避人格，也不从均分要求消除所有刺激或取消他人的安排；安全与既有支持保持独立，阅读可到此结束。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional available choice, selected seat and reason, with unknowns left open. No actual setting needs an account. A listener assigns no avoiding personality and uses no mean to eliminate all input or cancel another person’s arrangements. Safety and existing support remain separate; reading can end here.
